description:
Fast 3D model viewer for asset creators, with Explorer thumbnails.

PolyLoupe opens glTF/GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, PLY, 3MF, COLLADA and STEP files in about a second,
with Blender-style navigation and shading, texture channels, UV layout, mesh checks, measuring,
cross-sections, A/B compare and a Render tab with lights and soft shadows. The installer also
adds Explorer thumbnails for these formats.
